speaker: Doctor
text: That diagnosis contradicts the eosinophilic cells seen in your urine, which strongly suggests Acute Interstitial Nephritis rather than typical Pyelonephritis. Did you develop a rash or have joint pain after taking the antibiotics for your sinusitis? REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis. The history of a rash appearing after amoxicillin use, followed by improvement with cephalexin, combined with leukocyturia and eosinophilic crystals in the urine, is classic for a drug-induced allergic reaction affecting the kidneys. Please avoid any future exposure to penicillin-class antibiotics.
